CONTINUE EXECUTION NOW.

The previous STOP instruction is cancelled.

Complete every remaining blocker end-to-end, item by item.

Do not stop after coding.
Do not stop after local tests.
Do not stop after commit.
Do not stop after deployment.

Required completion:

1. Implement canonical login state machine.
2. Implement duplicate-tap and concurrent-login prevention.
3. Harden owner recovery against authentication-less access.
4. Add and pass automated tests for all 18 required auth scenarios.
5. Bump version to v1.10.2 / versionCode 100.
6. Commit real changes to GitHub.
7. Create PR and pass CI.
8. Merge without bypassing required checks.
9. Deploy exact merge SHA to Render.
10. Verify GitHub SHA = Render SHA = /health SHA = /version SHA.
11. Build fresh Android APK.
12. Verify APK download.
13. Perform physical-device login QA.
14. Verify login completes under 5 seconds where normal network conditions allow.
15. Verify no duplicate login requests.
16. Verify owner login.
17. Verify member login.
18. Verify logout/session restore/retry/network-loss behavior.

Do not fabricate SHAs, deploy IDs, test results, APK links, or device results.

If blocked, return the exact blocker with runtime evidence and continue with every independent item that can still be completed.

Final verdict must be exactly one:

END-TO-END COMPLETE

or

NOT END-TO-END COMPLETE
